title: 3DCodeVerse: Exploring 3D Worlds as Code
abstract: arXiv:2610.22341v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce 3DCodeVerse, a research ecosystem that enables coding agents to create editable and verifiable 3D content at scale. 3DCodeVerse comprises large-scale, high-quality datasets of executable 3D code, a coding harness for spatial reasoning and automated verification, and practical guidance for 3D coding. First, we construct 3DCodeVerse-2M, a large-scale curated dataset of standalone 3D executable code. We build this corpus by collecting open-source data, converting specialized representations, and generating new programs with coding agents. Each program is packaged with the source files and associated assets required for execution in its declared environment, along with available descriptions and verification records. Second, we develop the 3DCodeVerse Harness, a multi-agent directed acyclic graph framework for generating and refining 3D content. translated_abstract: 我们推出了3DCodeVerse，这是一个研究生态系统，使编码智能体能够大规模创建可编辑且可验证的3D内容。3DCodeVerse包含大规模、高质量的3D可执行代码数据集、用于空间推理和自动验证的编码工具框架，以及3D编码的实用指南。首先，我们构建了3DCodeVerse-2M，这是一个大规模精选的独立3D可执行代码数据集。我们通过收集开源数据、转换专业表示形式以及利用编码智能体生成新程序来构建该语料库。每个程序都打包了在其声明的环境中执行所需的源文件和相关资产，并附带可用的描述和验证记录。其次，我们开发了3DCodeVerse Harness，这是一个用于生成和精炼3D内容的多智能体有向无环图（DAG）框架。它利用执行检查、空间测量和视觉反馈来自动化……
tldr: 3DCodeVerse提出了一个让编码智能体大规模创建可编辑、可验证3D内容的研究生态系统，包含200万规模的可执行3D代码数据集和多智能体有向无环图生成验证框架。
en_tdlr: 3DCodeVerse introduces a research ecosystem enabling coding agents to create editable, verifiable 3D content at scale, featuring a 2M-scale dataset of standalone executable 3D code and a multi-agent DAG harness for automated generation and verification.
